description: This file provides utility functions for a weather dashboard frontend, including debouncing input, sanitizing search queries, and making safe fetch requests with error handling and timeouts.

methods.name: debounce(fn, delay = 400)
methods.description: Creates a debounced version of a function that delays execution until a specified period has passed without it being called again.

methods.name: sanitizeQuery(input)
methods.description: Sanitizes a search query string to prevent injection attacks and ensure safe URL usage by removing unwanted characters and collapsing whitespace.

methods.name: safeFetch(url, options = {}, timeoutMs = 8000)
methods.description: Performs a fetch request with error handling and timeout, aborting the request if it takes too long.
